meta.subject: Bahasa Melayu
meta.purpose: Master longitudinal graph for backtracking a current error to the earliest demonstrated prerequisite gap.

reading_comprehension: T3 analysis of information and graphical/textual material
T5 multi-source synthesis and critical response
writing_development: T3 structured introduction-body-conclusion and complete discourse
T5 reasoning-counterpoint-global cohesion and mature register
summary_synthesis: T5 multi-source integration and concise synthesis
grammar_morphology: T2 expanded word classes and specific formations
grammar_syntax: T3 broader phrase/sentence structure and transformation
literature: T4 deeper prose/poetry analysis and creative production
T5 evaluation, justification and mature literary response

engine_rules: Current-form failure triggers prerequisite inspection, not automatic downgrade.
Stop backtracking at the earliest prerequisite that has strong evidence of mastery.
If a prerequisite lacks evidence, classify it as unknown rather than weak.
Repair the earliest demonstrated weak node, then retest upward through the progression chain.
Keep curriculum mastery separate from exam-format performance.
Use repeated cross-date evidence to distinguish persistent weakness from temporary performance variation.
